text.p: NOBLE DRILLING CORPORATION AND SUBSIDIARIES SUMMARY OF RESULTS OF OPERATIONS

(A) For the quarter ended June 30, 1997, the amount includes operating costs and expenses of $139.8 million, offset by a gain of $197.7 million related to the sale of the Company's 12 mat-supported jackup rigs (plus the hull of one additional mat-supported unit).
(B) For the quarter ended June 30, 1997, the amount includes taxes of $69.2 million related to the gain on the sale of the mat rigs.
(C) The amount relates to the Company's purchase of $81.3 million principal amount of its 9 1/4 % Senior Notes Due 2003.
Income Before Income Taxes and Extraordinary Charge
Net Income Applicable to Common Shares 178,663 23,959
Net Income Applicable to Common Shares Per Share:

(1) For the six months ended June 30, 1997, the amount includes operating costs and expenses of $273.4 million, partially offset by a gain of $197.7 million related to the sale of the Company's 12 mat-supported jackup rigs (plus the hull of one additional mat-supported unit). For the six months ended June 30, 1996, the amount includes gains of $7.5 million related to the sale of two posted barge rigs, offset by an impairment charge of $7.6 million.
(2) For the six months ended June 30, 1997, the amount includes taxes of $69.2 million related to the gain on the sale of the mat rigs.
(3) The amount relates to the Company's purchase of $110.9 million principal amount of its 9 1/4% Senior Notes Due 2003.
